candidate.name: QAKR
candidate.boundaryRule: full cell for each in-domain raster node; out-of-domain queries return zero

runtime.approximateArithmetic: about 28465344 GL nodes, each using one exp, one cos/sin pair and two 24-term erf series; plus 784264 value-weight accumulations
runtime.currentBilinearPerQuery: four raster node reads, four bilinear weights, three linear blends
runtime.qakrMemory: no LUT; 24-point Gauss-Legendre constants plus one shared 96x96 Float32 raster (36,864 bytes per arm)
runtime.lutPossibility: The cell-phase-dependent basis is 4-fold symmetric and compactly supported; a precomputed table could trade bounded memory for fewer quadratures, but was not used or benchmarked.

limitingCosts: local steering MAE and phase spread worsen despite lower raw-value MAE
fixed 24-point quadrature is far more expensive than bilinear sampling
decisionRationale.movementGate: Not qualified for movement shadow: local qualitative errors rise, targeted recoveries are small, and the straight false-steering control worsens. Stop here; do not tune or test another reader.
